user.title: Smart Water
user.description: A live hub uses your weather and stores on/off entities. A simulation hub uses example zones and a weather week you describe. Neither one opens a valve.

live.title: Smart Water hub
live.description: Name the hub, then pick a weather entity or open Sensors and pick a temperature sensor. A Tempest station is filled in when one is found. Location and schedule already have defaults. This version plans and records. It does not open a valve.

data_description.weather_entity: Optional when a temperature sensor is set. Used for the forecast and for any sensor you leave empty.

sensors.name: Sensors
sensors.description: Optional. Open this when you have a Tempest or other local sensors. A temperature sensor here can replace the weather entity.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Required only if you leave the weather entity empty.
data_description.uv_sensor: Used only when solar radiation is empty. About 100 W/m² per UV index, not an FAO factor.
data_description.rain_amount_sensor: Preferred over the weather forecast. Daily total matches Tempest rain today.
data_description.rain_kind: Daily total replaces the day's rain. Cumulative adds increases and ignores the first sample. Rate is mm/h, integrated between updates.

location.name: Location and schedule
location.description: Defaults match the central Texas design site (about 219 m) and water any day. Change these only if you need to. Dry-run is off. v0.4 still will not water.

data.plan_hour: Hour to commit the daily balance and notify
data.forecast_skip_mm: Skip when forecast rain is at least

data_description.elevation_m: Used for Penman-Monteith air pressure when no pressure sensor is set. Home Assistant often stores 0.
data_description.latitude: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's location. Set both latitude and longitude, or neither.
data_description.longitude: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's location.
data_description.notify_target: Example: mobile_app_phone, or notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty sends nothing.
data_description.forecast_skip_mm: Leave empty to disable. A 0.25 inch rule is not assumed.
data_description.earliest_hour: Local hour on the morning of the run. Empty means the plan only has to finish by sunrise.
data_description.round_minutes: On keeps every cycle a whole minute. Off keeps tenths of a minute.
data_description.schedule_preset: None uses every day. Waco presets ignore the custom days and hours below. Custom uses the weekdays and blackout you set.
data_description.allowed_weekdays: Used only with the custom preset. Leave empty to allow every day.
data_description.blackout_start_hour: First hour when watering is not allowed, local time. Used by None and Custom. Waco always uses 10.
data_description.blackout_end_hour: First hour when watering is allowed again. Used by None and Custom. Waco always uses 19.
data_description.drip_ignores_schedule: Buried drip may skip the weekday check. The blackout still applies. Off by default.

simulation.title: Simulation hub
simulation.description: No weather entity, sensor, or on/off entity is required. Pick an example week and how full the soil starts. Zones are dropdowns only and use virtual valves. The week uses the same planner as a live hub and does not open a valve.

data_description.scenario: An example week, not a forecast and not a climate normal. Change it later in options or with the simulate service.
data_description.bucket: Full is field capacity. Half is half the root zone used. Raw is ready to water.

location.name: Location and schedule
location.description: Defaults match the central Texas design site (about 219 m) and water any day. The simulated mornings use this sunrise and this schedule.

data.plan_hour: Hour to commit the daily balance and notify
data.forecast_skip_mm: Skip when forecast rain is at least

data_description.latitude: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's location. Set both latitude and longitude, or neither.
data_description.longitude: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's location.
data_description.forecast_skip_mm: Leave empty to disable. Tomorrow's simulated rain skips a zone only when this is set.
data_description.schedule_preset: None uses every day. Waco presets ignore the custom days and hours below.

reconfigure.title: Update the hub
reconfigure.description: Clear the weather entity only if a temperature sensor is already set under options.

data_description.weather_entity: Leave empty to remove it. A temperature sensor must remain.

error.latitude_pair: Set both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
error.need_weather: Pick a weather entity or a temperature sensor.

init.title: Smart Water options
init.description: Sensors and the schedule. A simulation hub also keeps the weather week and the starting soil here. Dry-run defaults off. v0.4 still does not water.

data_description.scenario: Used the next time the simulation runs. A custom days list replaces it for that one run.
data_description.bucket: Full is field capacity. Half is half the root zone used. Raw is ready to water.

sensors.name: Sensors
sensors.description: Entity sensors are preferred. The weather entity is the fallback.

data_description.uv_sensor: Used only when solar radiation is empty. About 100 W/m² per UV index, not an FAO factor.
data_description.rain_kind: Daily total replaces the day's rain. Cumulative adds increases and ignores the first sample. Rate is mm/h, integrated between updates.

data.plan_hour: Hour to commit the daily balance and notify
data.forecast_skip_mm: Skip when forecast rain is at least

data_description.notify_target: Example: mobile_app_phone, or notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty sends nothing.
data_description.schedule_preset: None uses every day. Waco presets ignore the custom days and hours. Custom uses the weekdays and blackout you set.
data_description.allowed_weekdays: Used only with the custom preset.
data_description.drip_ignores_schedule: Weekday check only. The blackout still applies.

user.title: Zone
user.description: On a live hub, pick the on/off entity, plant, soil, sprinkler, and sun. On a simulation hub there is no on/off entity. Optional area and slope are on this step. The next step is optional. Blank means the preset. Nothing is turned on.

data_description.valve_entity: Switch, valve, or input boolean. Stored only. A simulation zone uses a virtual valve instead and nothing is turned on.
data_description.plant_type: Sets the crop coefficient, root depth, and depletion unless you override them.
data_description.soil_type: Sets available water and the intake rate.
data_description.sprinkler_type: Sets the precipitation rate and efficiency. Bubbler has no published rate, so the next step asks for one.
data_description.sun_exposure: Scales the crop coefficient. Full sun is 1.0.
data_description.area_sqft: Optional. Used to estimate gallons. Leave blank if you do not know it.
data_description.slope_pct: Optional. Blank uses 0%, the NRCS 0–5% intake band.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Leave a field blank to keep its preset. Root depth {root_depth} in. Available water {awc} in/in. Intake {intake} in/hr at {slope}% slope. Depletion {mad}. Crop coefficient {kc} this month (annual {kc_annual}, sun factor {sun}). Precipitation {precip} in/hr. Efficiency {efficiency}.

plant_overrides.name: Plant and soil
plant_overrides.description: Blank uses the plant and soil preset.

data_description.root_depth_in: Preset {root_depth} in. Leave blank to use it.
data_description.awc_override: Preset {awc} in/in. Leave blank to use it.
data_description.intake_in_hr: Preset {intake} in/hr. Leave blank to use it.
data_description.depletion_fraction: Preset {mad}. Leave blank to use it. FAO still adjusts this for today's crop ET.
data_description.kc_override: Preset {kc} for this month, including sun. Leave blank to use it. A number here replaces the plant coefficient and the sun factor.

hardware_overrides.name: Hardware
hardware_overrides.description: Blank uses the sprinkler preset. Slope blank uses 0%, the NRCS 0–5% band.

data_description.precipitation_rate_in_hr: Preset {precip} in/hr. Leave blank to use it. An entered rate wins over flow and area.
data_description.efficiency: Preset {efficiency}. Leave blank to use it.
data_description.slope_pct: Preset {slope}%. Leave blank to use it.
data_description.max_cycle_min: Leave blank to use the intake rate and precipitation rate.
data_description.soak_min: Leave blank to use the soil default. Drip and bubbler soak 0 unless you set one.
data_description.flow_gpm: Leave blank unless you want the rate calculated from flow and area.
data_description.area_sqft: Used with flow to compute inches per hour (96.25 × GPM / area). Also used for the flow check.

measurement_overrides.name: Moisture, flow, and priority
measurement_overrides.description: Optional. Moisture and flow only label the plan. They do not open or close anything.

data_description.priority: Lower numbers run first when two zones are both ready.
data_description.moisture_mode: Off ignores the sensor. Correct blends it into the bucket once per day. Override replaces the bucket on every update.
data_description.moisture_kind: Relative is percent of available water (0–100, or a 0–1 fraction). Volumetric needs field capacity.
data_description.flow_sensor: Any sensor that reports a volume total or a flow rate. Used to flag low flow and leaks. Nothing is closed.
data_description.flow_low_ratio: Delivered ÷ expected below this, after the run window, is low flow. Default 0.5.
data_description.flow_leak_ratio: Delivered ÷ expected above this is a leak. Default 1.5. Unscheduled delivery of at least 1 gallon is also a leak.

error.name_exists: A zone with this name already exists.
error.precipitation_rate: Enter a precipitation rate, or both flow and area. Bubblers need one of those. Other sprinklers can leave both blank.

options.auto: Auto (still blocked in v0.4, and while dry-run is on)

options.correct: Correct the bucket once a day
options.override: Override the bucket on every update

calculate_plan.name: Calculate plan
calculate_plan.description: Build tonight's plan. Does not open a valve.

reset_bucket.name: Reset bucket
reset_bucket.description: Set a zone's deficit to zero. Does not open a valve.

set_bucket.name: Set bucket
set_bucket.description: Set a zone's deficit in millimeters or inches. Does not open a valve.

mark_watered.name: Mark watered
mark_watered.description: Credit net irrigation that already happened. Does not open a valve.

skip_zone.name: Skip zone
skip_zone.description: Leave a zone out of the plan through a date.

pause_zone.name: Pause zone
pause_zone.description: Skip a zone for a number of days. Zero clears the pause. Does not open a valve.

set_adjustment.name: Set adjustment
set_adjustment.description: Scale a zone's planned depth. 100 is unchanged. Does not open a valve.

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Log the planned run. Does not call the zone's on/off entity.

simulate.name: Simulate a week
simulate.description: Play a weather week through the planner. Does not open a valve or change the stored bucket.
